items.title: After playing a bit of Lego Skylines, it seems like a city builder for people who care less about traffic jams and more about decorating
items.summary: A short preview revealed a cozy and calm builder with some gorgeous views.
items.body: It makes so much sense I can't believe it didn't happen years ago: as revealed at Gamescom last week, Lego is finally fulfilling its destiny by making a city builder . And I'm happy to say I got my eager hands on an early build of Lego Skylines for a little preview. I do want to make this clear: the preview build I played was very short, with only about 35 minutes of playtime. It was almost entirely focused on building one small neighborhood, with the population maxing out at around 50 residents by the end of the preview. That's not quite long enough, or big enough, to get a real feel for a city builder. But what's here is immediately appealing. The little Lego world I worked on was simply lovely. Click to build a house and it'll quickly be constructed in a colorful shower of Lego bricks falling from the sky and piling up into a cozy-looking little home. Bulldoze a mistake and the building will collapse into a heap of plastic bricks on the ground. The cute animations and cheery visuals are exactly what I'd hoped for when I saw the game's trailer last week, and again made me wonder why Lego didn't make a city builder years ago. items.title: Resident Evil 2's director believes Capcom has become 'completely numb to how scary' recent games have been and wants a 'non-horror mode'
items.summary: Ok, so, the zombies don't want to eat you, they just want a hug—wait, that's still scary.
items.body: Something's wrong with me. No matter how many horror games I play, I just can't get scared like I used to. Perhaps I'm the problem—maybe a decade of playing horror games pretty much non-stop has irrevocably altered my brain chemistry. Take Resident Evil Requiem , for example—that just doesn't make the cut for a horror game in my book. Apart from the first five minutes in the underground cells, there just wasn't anything that felt particularly scary. In fact, I don't believe that any horror game that gives me a gun can be scary, except for Amnesia: The Bunker—I genuinely thought that game was going to kill me. Again, I find myself thinking that there's something up with my nervous system, because even Hideki Kamiya, director of Resident Evil 2 , would disagree with me. He believes that Capcom has become blind to just how scary its recent games have become. "I've never been a fan of horror. I mean, even from the time I was young, I could never handle it," Kamiya says in an interview with VGC . "I don’t like horror, and I don’t like scary things. items.title: 30,000 games are either Steam Deck verified or at least 'playable' on Valve's handheld
items.summary: Hands on, and on the go.
items.body: Valve's handheld launched in February 2022, opening the door to playing your Steam library on the go. Now, almost half a decade later, 30,000 games either enjoy the green stamp of being Steam Deck verified, or are at least considered 'playable.' According to the latest numbers from SteamDB that breaks down to 8,964 Steam Deck Verified games and 21,083 games considered 'playable' on the handheld (via Gaming On Linux ). That's a big jump from the 3,000 games either Verified or Playable back in May 2022 . 'Verified' means your game of choice should work great on the Steam Deck from first boot, whereas 'Playable' games require either some finagling or adjustments for the best experience. Steam Deck verification is also joined by similar compatibility checks for the Steam Machine , the soon-to-be-released Steam Frame , and SteamOS more broadly. I make the whole thing sound straightforward, but it's worth noting that the Steam Deck's full verification criteria can present developers with confusing hoops to jump through . items.body: موسم الحسم.. ثورة تغيير مرتقبة في دفاع الشياطين الحمر بدأ مانشستر يونايتد التحضير لإعادة تشكيل خطه الخلفي، مع اتجاه النادي لإجراء تغييرات كبيرة في صيف 2027، بعد تقييم عدد من المدافعين خلال الموسم الحالي. ووفقا لما نقله موقع كوت أوفسايد عن صحيفة ذا صن، يستهدف النادي التعاقد مع ما يصل إلى ثلاثة مدافعين جدد، في ظل وجود علامات استفهام حول مستقبل عدد من عناصر الخط الخلفي. ويواجه لوك شذو، وهاري ماجواير، ليساندرو مارتينيز وماتياس دي ليخت اختبارًا مهمًا لإثبات قدرتهم على الاستمرار، بينما ينتهي عقد شو بنهاية الموسم. ووفقا للمصدر نفسه، لا يبدو أن ليني يورو وأيدن هيفن مهددان بالرحيل، باعتبارهما من العناصر التي يعول عليها النادي مستقبلًا. وقد تمتد عملية التقييم إلى مركزي الظهيرين، مع خضوع ديوجو دالوت ونصير مزراوي للمراجعة خلال الموسم، فيما قد يعاود مانشستر يونايتد اهتمامه بالظهير الأيسر لنيوكاسل، لويس هول، بعدما فشل في ضمه خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية التي أغلقت أبوابها أمس. ويعكس المخطط المرتقب أهمية موسم 2026-2027 بالنسبة لمدافعي مانشستر يونايتد، إذ ستكون الجاهزية والاستمرارية عاملين حاسمين إلى جانب المستوى الفني، قبل اتخاذ قرارات الصيف المقبل. اقرأ أيضا: نهاية الأزمة.. العيناوي إلى الدوري الألماني رسميا

items.body: أسهمت لاليجا في تطوير كرة القدم العراقية وتعزيز هياكلها ودعم المواهب الشابة، لتترك إرثًا مستدامًا لكرة القدم في العراق اختتمت رابطة الدوري الإسباني لكرة (لاليجا) مشروعها للاستشارات وتطوير كرة القدم مع الاتحاد العراقي لكرة القدم، والذي انطلق في عام 2023، وذلك عقب انتهاء مدة العقد الأصلي وفترة لاحقة من المفاوضات، قدمت خلالها لاليجا مجموعة من البدائل الهادفة إلى وضع إطار جديد لاستمرار التعاون. مشروع حظي بدعم من أعلى المستويات وقال خابيير تيباس رئيس لاليجا: "يمتلك العراق واحدة من أكثر القواعد الجماهيرية شغفاً والتزاماً بكرة القدم في العالم، وقد شكّل هذا الحماس مصدر إلهام دائم لفريق عملنا طوال هذه السنوات الثلاث. كل ما بنيناه معاً يمثل إرثاً لكرة القدم العراقية. وأنا على قناعة بأن الأسس التي أرسيناها راسخة، ولديّ ثقة بأن المسؤولين عنها الآن سيعرفون كيفية الحفاظ عليها والعمل على تطويرها". وكان الاتفاق قد انطلق في عام 2023 بقيادة عدنان درجال، رئيس الاتحاد العراقي لكرة القدم آنذاك، حيث خصصت لاليجا منذ البداية فريقًا دائمًا للعمل على الأرض في بغداد، مدعومًا بمئات المتخصصين من مقرها الرئيسي في مدريد ومكاتبها الدولية. كما حظي المشروع منذ انطلاقته بمشاركة مباشرة من خابيير تيباس، رئيس لاليجا، الذي أشرف شخصيًا على تطوره وزار العراق في مناسبات عديدة. أبرز المحطات: تطوير الأعمال والمسابقات الاحتر…

items.title: Former id Software producer says the team faced the 'worst crunch' in the series' history on Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations: 'There were days where I didn't see my son'
items.summary: "There were two months where I was working something like at least 12 hours every day."
items.body: The situation surrounding Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations was already grim. Id Software put out a fantastic expansion that addressed many issues present in the ( still pretty good ) base game, placing it among the best works the FPS specialists have ever produced. The reward for many of The Dark Ages team was to be instantly laid off , as Xbox cut 136 members of the studio's workforce. Now, it also appears that getting Revelations to the finish line was a punishing experience for those involved, at least according to former id Software producer Andrew Willis. Speaking on the Kiwi Talkz podcast for Insider Gaming , Willis revealed that the team experienced a gnarly level of crunch in the months leading up to Revelations' release. "It was tight," Willis explained. "There were two months where I was working something like at least 12 hours every day. I know I hit 17 a couple of days." Willis goes on to describe the experience as "brutal" and says that most of the expansion was put together "in three or four months." items.title: The future of GTA roleplaying remains in GTA 5 for now, as Rockstar touts new invite-only Nopixel V RP server
items.summary: Rockstar collaborated with Nopixel Studios for the latest version of its custom GTA 5 roleplaying experience, which includes 1,000 ownable properties.
items.body: Rockstar announced today that Nopixel V is "the next evolution of the GTA 5 roleplay community," which has led to some head-scratching from casual GTA RP followers (like myself), because Nopixel V isn't something you or I can just jump into and play. Nopixel Studios runs both public and private GTA 5 roleplaying servers, and Nopixel V is the latest version of its modded sandbox. The Nopixel V beta was developed in collaboration with Rockstar, and will be accessible through the Rockstar Games Launcher, but only for invited streamers, a list of whom can be found on the Nopixel website . "Over time, access [to Nopixel V] will expand, including more phases of invites," Nopixel announced on its Discord server earlier in August. However, "for everyone on nopixel Public and nopixel 4.0, nothing changes." So, at least for now, it doesn't sound like there's a way into the Nopixel V improv troupe other than being called up from one of the minor leagues. Rockstar's announcement thus focuses not on the opportunity to play Nopixel V, but to watch it being played by streamers. items.summary: Rat's all, folks.
items.body: Need to know What is it?: Plague Tale prequel goes full third-person action-adventure. Expect to pay: £44/$50 Developer: Asobo Publisher: Focus Reviewed on: Windows 11, Intel Core i9, 32GB RAM, Nvidia RTX 4060 Multiplayer?: No Steam Deck: Playable Link: Official site The Plague Tale series were puzzle-stealth games about kids trying to survive a Horrible History version of France during the Hundred Years War, sneaking past soldiers and using light to frighten hordes of rats that could strip them to bones in an instant. I loved their atmosphere of pulpy Grand Guignol supernatural history, but didn't love a lot of the actual videogame parts. Too often a fussy sneaking section would end with an accidental step over an arbitrary line, then back to a checkpoint at the start of the area. In the second game, A Plague Tale: Requiem, I once had to skip through two cutscenes to get back to the beginning of the section I died at—a sin I might have uninstalled the game for if I were less invested in the story. items.body: While the legendarily absurd complexity of fantasy simulation in Dwarf Fortress provides countless perils for dwarven health and happiness, the most insidious threat to any mountain hall emerges from within: Nobility. As a fortress flourishes, it inevitably draws the attention of dwarven nobles who'll needlessly burrow themselves into industries they're not qualified to direct, issuing demands and mandates without any care for whether they're feasible or sustainable for the rest of dwarven society. Sounds unbelievable, I know. But there are ways to manage the menace of nobility—like simply walling them off in an unpleasant corner and letting the rest of society live and labor as need, preference, urgency, and capacity allow. items.body: I've made my feelings about Micro-OLED displays pretty clear: these tiny screens are the future of high-end virtual reality. Well, good news, the Assembly Bill 1856 amendment has just passed and it exempts open-source operating systems from compliance. As reported by Tom's Hardware , the amendment passed with a 39-0 vote. items.body: It is high time I paid for my crimes. There are things I've done that can't be forgiven, mostly relating to that time I drove a Chinese anti-air missile truck into Beverly Hills, and someone should make me face consequences for that. Alas, in GTA 5 , no one will unless I make them. So I made them. I have installed Ambient Hit Squads , a mod inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2 that will dispatch armed men to eliminate you every so often as you're out exploring the game's world. This functions more or less as it should in my nightmare-frankenstein version of GTA, already lumbering under so many mods. Once in a while, my map will bloom with red dots as armed assassins arrive to kill me, and the clatter of gunfire will join the now-constant chorus of cars ramming each other, pedestrians, geometry, me, and themselves.
